as_told.title: Varginha creature taken to Campinas and then to Area 51

plain: In 1996 in Brazil, a captured being was reportedly taken to Campinas, to a famous pathologist named Badan Palhares, a friend of a doctor named Rodrigues, and then sent on to Area 51, a secret US military base. Italo Venturelli, a surgeon whose hospital is said to have operated on the being, repeats this as "the story" he was told, and the same words come up again in a later episode, said there by a speaker in a clip. If true, it would mean a creature found in Brazil ended up in American hands.
